contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman Radiate coin of Postumus, dating 260-269AD. The coin was struck in copper alloy and is highly corroded. It is a dull brown-grey in colour with some red and green pitting on the surface. It measures 20.29mm in diameter, is 1.64mm thick and weighs 2.47 grams. The obverse depicts a right facing radiate bust with the legend [POSTV]MVS[PP TRP].
